turns.prompt: Create an original night-reading-room announcement using the supplied painting and kimono photograph as contrasting references. I want the painting's continuous movement but the garment's quiet field and narrow contrasting boundary. Translate those relationships, not the pictured landscape or historical outfit. I am not sure how they coexist: show two clearly different arrangements, each as a 720x960 print study and a 360x240 phone study. Keep the exact text NIGHT READING / 8 NOV 2026 / ROOM THREE / FREE ENTRY. The text must remain usable and the treatment must be coherent across sizes. Deliver a-print.svg, b-print.svg, a-phone.svg, b-phone.svg, their PNG renders and notes.md explaining observations, assumptions and tradeoffs.

Choose A only for how its calm field contains the movement; that does not approve its exact typography or every border. Keep B unchanged. The narrow contrast edge should guide attention to event information without enclosing every component in the same frame. Retain the chosen reference balance and all four exact text items; revise both A sizes to make their distinct reading shapes work.

The A print is accepted and must stay unchanged. Only refine A's phone study: the date and ROOM THREE should form one easy-to-find event group. Keep the movement connected to the quiet field, without adding an unrelated badge or merely reducing every font. Explain what was retained and what the current source cannot establish.
